title: SearchLog: A Web Browser Extension for Capturing Search Logs in Laboratory Studies
abstract: arXiv:2606.05040v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Natural search logs are valuable for studying search behavior in information seeking settings. We present SearchLog, an easy-to-install web browser extension for collecting natural search logs during lab-based studies. SearchLog enables participants to search the open web in a browser while recording structured interaction data from the mouse, keyboard, search activity, and browser state modules. The extension captures clicks, scrolling, hovered text, typed words, search queries, result rankings, AI-generated summaries when available, tab activity, and window changes. A local Flask backend stores each session as an ordered JSON event stream, including HTML snapshots and preprocessed search result data for later analysis. These logs can be used to derive measures such as query reformulation, page visits, dwell time, scroll behavior, tab switching, search path complexity, and exposure to AI-generated search content. translated_title: SearchLog：一个用于在实验室研究中捕获搜索日志的网页浏览器扩展
translated_abstract: 自然搜索日志对于研究信息获取场景中的搜索行为具有重要价值。我们提出了SearchLog，一个易于安装的网页浏览器扩展，用于在实验室研究中收集自然搜索日志。SearchLog使参与者能够在浏览器中搜索开放网络，同时记录来自鼠标、键盘、搜索活动和浏览器状态模块的结构化交互数据。该扩展可捕获点击、滚动、悬停文本、输入的词语、搜索查询、结果排名、AI生成的摘要（如可用）、标签页活动以及窗口变化。本地Flask后端将每个会话存储为有序的JSON事件流，其中包括HTML快照和经过预处理的搜索结果数据，以便后续分析。这些日志可用于推导诸如查询重构、页面访问、停留时间、滚动行为、标签页切换、搜索路径复杂度以及接触AI生成搜索内容等测量指标。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SearchLog是一个易于安装的浏览器扩展，能在实验室研究中自然地记录参与者在开放网络上搜索时的鼠标、键盘、搜索活动与浏览器状态等多维交互数据，并支持推导查询重构、停留时间、搜索路径复杂度及AI生成摘要接触等搜索行为指标。
en_tdlr: SearchLog is an easy-to-install browser extension that captures natural search logs—including mouse, keyboard, search, and browser-state interactions—in laboratory studies, enabling measures such as query reformulation, dwell time, and exposure to AI-generated search summaries.
